page.title: What's new
page.subtitle: The latest updates and improvements
page.madeWith: Made with <heart></heart> for your special moments

v3_2_0.title: Loy Krathong Online 2026 — Nong Pu Village is open
v3_2_0.summary: A free Loy Krathong mini-game, open from today until 26 Nov. Dress up your crab, walk around the village, pick a krathong at the shop and make a wish at the pier with everyone else. Find it under the "Loy Krathong" tab on your dashboard.
items: Name your crab, pick a shell colour and an accessory; walk with a joystick on mobile or W A S D on desktop
Pick one of six free krathongs at the shop and float it with a wish at the pier; everyone shares one river
Four scenes to explore: Nong Pu Village, the temple, Bangkok riverside and Chiang Mai; walk off the left or right edge to change scene
See other players in real time and chat once signed in

v3_1_0.title: Meet the crab, The Memory’s new mascot
v3_1_0.summary: A pink pixel-art crab is now the face of The Memory. You will see it in the top bar, as the app icon, and scuttling across the home page where you can tap it.
items: New logo and app icon: the pink pixel-art crab. Reinstall the app to refresh the icon on your phone.
The crab has moods: happy after a successful payment, a wink on the PIN screen, sad when a payment is cancelled, and it walks across the home page. Tap it for a reaction.
Loading screens now show the walking crab instead of the spinning heart.

v3_0_0.title: The Memory now speaks 3 languages — Thai, English, Indonesian
v3_0_0.summary: The Memory is now available in Thai, English and Bahasa Indonesia. Switch language any time — and when you send a memory to someone abroad, the link opens in their language automatically.
items: Three languages — ไทย, English, Bahasa Indonesia. Switch any time from the language button in the top bar.
Send a memory to someone abroad — your shared link opens in the recipient's language automatically.
Checkout and notifications now appear in the language you use.
International users can pay by credit or debit card (PromptPay stays available for users in Thailand).

v2_9_0.title: Take your time — no more countdown
v2_9_0.summary: Stories no longer flip every 5 seconds. Each one stays put until you tap or click to move on, so you can read and linger for as long as you like. The Instagram-style progress bar stays exactly as it was.
items: View memories with no time limit — stories don't advance on their own any more. Tap the right side to go forward, the left side to go back (or use the arrow keys on a computer).
The IG Stories-style progress bar is still there, showing which story you're on and how many are left.
Fixed PromptPay payments (especially on Safari) where the money went through but the status never updated — payments are now confirmed and memories activated automatically.

v2_8_1.title: Universe now shows PIN-protected stories too
v2_8_1.summary: With "Share to Universe" on, all of a memory's image and text stories appear in the feed — including the ones behind a PIN. The PIN still protects the viewing sequence of your link, exactly as before.
items: Sharing to Universe now means sharing all image and text stories, including those behind a PIN (you can turn sharing off at any time).
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use updated to version 1.1 to match the new behaviour.

v2_8_0.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Use
v2_8_0.summary: New Privacy Policy (PDPA) and Terms of Use pages, plus an acceptance step before sign-in — so it's clear exactly how we look after your data.
items: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use pages, readable any time from the footer.
New users read and accept the terms before signing in; existing users confirm once from the home page.
We don't sell your data, and you can request access to it, correct it or delete it under your PDPA rights.

v2_7_0.title: Universe — a feed of stories from everyone
v2_7_0.summary: A new "Universe" tab collecting image and text stories from memories that other people have shared. Scroll through them like a social feed, and send a reaction to the creator.
items: New "Universe" tab on the home page — scroll through other people's stories in random order, with more loading automatically as you go.
React (❤️ 😍 🥹 🔥 🙏) to stories in Universe — the creator is notified straight away.
Choose whether or not to share a memory to Universe, both while creating it and from the home page (sharing is on by default).
Privacy: stories behind a PIN never appear in Universe.

v2_6_0.title: Send a heart & reply to a memory
v2_6_0.summary: At the end of a memory, the person you sent it to can send a heart or write you a reply — and you're notified the moment they do.
items: Send a feeling at the end of a memory — the recipient can pick an emoji (❤️ 😍 🥹 🔥 🙏) to send to the creator.
Write a short reply back to the person who made the memory.
Creators get a notification (in-app and push) the instant someone sends a heart or a reply.

v2_5_0.title: New story types — voice message & photo album
v2_5_0.summary: Two new kinds of story: say it in your own voice, or turn a handful of photos into a beautiful slideshow.
items: Voice message story — record or upload audio for someone special, up to 1 minute long.
Photo album story — combine 2-5 photos into a slideshow with a soft zoom effect.

v2_4_0.title: Notifications & a new memory ending
v2_4_0.summary: In-app and push notifications, 10 free credits for turning them on, a brand-new ending screen with replay, and a sign-in fix.
items: New notification system — a two-tab bell (notifications + updates) bringing news and release history together in one place.
Push notifications — get notified on your device even when the app isn't open.
Turn notifications on for the first time and get 10 free credits!
Manage your notifications — dismiss them one by one, or clear them all.
A new ending screen when a memory finishes — replay it, create one of your own, and enjoy a little heart celebration.
Fixed getting stuck on the "Connecting" screen after signing out and back in.

v2_3_0.title: Install it as an app! (PWA)
v2_3_0.summary: Add The Memory to your home screen like a real app — faster to open, full screen, with an offline fallback page.
items: Install it to your home screen on Android, iOS and desktop (PWA).
Opens full screen like a native app, with no browser bars and a quick start.
An offline page with a retry button when you lose connection.
Text length limits per story with a character counter, so everything looks right on every screen.

v2_2_0.title: New landing pages for every occasion
v2_2_0.summary: Six new landing pages with content tailored to each occasion, so people can find us more easily.
items: /anniversary — anniversaries, with tailored copy and sample messages.
/birthday — birthdays, with ideas for what to write.
/valentine — Valentine's Day gifts.
/reconcile — making up, with sample apology messages.
/family — telling your family you love them.
/missyou — sending someone how much you miss them.

v2_1_1.title: Long messages now scroll
v2_1_1.summary: Text and text+image stories can now be scrolled when the content runs past the screen.
items: Long text in text and text+image stories now scrolls, in both preview and live mode.
The heading stays fixed at the top while you scroll, making long content easier to read.

v2_1_0.title: Instagram Stories-style viewing
v2_1_0.summary: A complete rework of the memory viewer in the style of IG Stories — tap left/right to move, a segmented progress bar, and full screen.
items: Tap the screen to change story (just like IG Stories).
Segmented progress bar — shows how many stories there are, filling automatically every 5 seconds.
Keyboard support — use the left/right arrow keys to move between stories on desktop.

v2_0_0.title: The Memory 2.0 — a memory platform for every occasion
v2_0_0.summary: A big rebrand! Four new colour themes, six use-case pages, a warmer palette, and analytics.
items: Rebranded as a "Digital Memory & Emotion Platform" — for every occasion, not just Valentine's.
Four new colour themes — anniversary (gold), birthday (orange), apology (purple), missing you (blue), for 7 in total.
Six use-case pages — surprise gift, anniversary, birthday, apology, missing you, family, all SEO-ready.
Social proof on the home page — reviews from real users.
Analytics — tracking user behaviour across the whole funnel.
A completely new home page — use case navigator, accordion FAQ, trust badges.
A warmer palette — from deep pink to warm neutral, suited to everyone.
Seven theme options with a mood description on the create page.
Clearer payment copy — "Just 99 baht, yours forever, share it as often as you like".
Softer heart effects — lighter colours, fewer of them.

v1_8_0.title: User profiles & toasts
v1_8_0.summary: Fill in your profile and get 10 free credits, plus a brand-new notification style.
items: User profiles — add a few more details (phone, birthday, gender, occupation, relationship status, occasion).
Onboarding page — welcoming new users with a profile form.
Get 10 free credits for completing your profile!
A dashboard modal inviting you to fill in your profile.
The profile page is now editable — with a form for changing your details.
Toast notifications — replacing alerts with something far nicer to look at.

v1_6_0.title: Turn real photos into cartoons
v1_6_0.summary: Upload a photo of the two of you and turn it into an adorable cartoon!
items: Cartoon generation — upload a photo and turn it into a cartoon with AI (costs 10 credits).
Cartoon gallery — view and download everything you've made.
Tabs on the dashboard — switch between your memories and the cartoon creator.

v1_5_0.title: Credits
v1_5_0.summary: Buy credits as a package — cheaper, and your memories activate instantly.
items: Credit system — buy credit packages, with a discount when you buy more.
Credit balance in the app bar, plus a page to manage credits and see your history.
Three packages to choose from: 100, 300 and 500 credits.

v1_4_0.title: App bar, profile & updates page
v1_4_0.summary: A restructured app with an app bar, update notifications, and a profile page.
items: App bar — a top navigation bar with the logo, notification bell and user menu.
Profile page — see your picture, name, email and the date you joined.
"What's new" page — browse the release history, with a notification whenever there's something new.
Restructured into an (app) route group so every page shares the app bar.
A tidier dashboard, with the menu moved into the app bar.

v1_3_0.title: Question stories & adding a referral code later
v1_3_0.summary: A new question story type, plus the option to enter a referral code after signing up.
items: Question story — ask a question with four answers for someone special to pick from.
Add a referral code retroactively, for anyone who skipped it the first time.
Fixed two scratch cards sharing the same state.
Fixed the webhook for PromptPay payments.

v1_2_0.title: Refer a friend
v1_2_0.summary: Share your code with a friend and get 50 baht off.
items: Referral codes — share your code with friends and get 50 baht off.
Request your referral earnings via PromptPay or bank transfer.

v1_1_0.title: Scratch cards & site statistics
v1_1_0.summary: A new scratch-to-reveal story type, and live numbers on the home page.
items: Scratch card story — scratch to reveal what's underneath.
Animated statistics on the home page.
Automatic WebP image conversion for speed.

v1_0_0.title: The Memory is live!
v1_0_0.summary: Create something unforgettable for the person you love.
items: Our very first release!
Create a memory with 5 story types: text, image, image + text, YouTube and password.
6-digit PIN lock with a numpad.
Share via QR code, copy the link, or share through any app.
Payment through Stripe (card & PromptPay).
